review.en: A magistrate's daughter dreams of a young man in a spring garden, pines for him, and the play follows that longing past the boundary of death. Tang Xianzu wrote it in fifty-five scenes for the southern stage, and its garden scenes remain at the heart of the Kunqu repertoire. Few works argue so boldly that feeling can be stronger than life.
review.zh: 太守之女杜丽娘游园入梦，梦中遇见书生，醒后相思成疾，情意竟越过了生死的界限。汤显祖写成五十五出的传奇，《游园》《惊梦》至今是昆曲最常演的折子。很少有作品这样大胆地主张“情”可以比生死更有力量，读剧本时文辞本身就很美。
